2607.18693.title: Rationale-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Cross-Lingual Stance Detection
2607.18693.paper_summary: Stance detection aims to identify whether a text expresses a favorable or opposing attitude toward a given target, and serves as an important task for various downstream applications. Although existing studies have achieved strong performance in monolingual settings, especially in English, many low-resource languages such as Catalan still lack sufficient annotated data for training effective models. Cross-lingual stance detection alleviates this problem by transferring stance knowledge from resource-rich languages to low-resource languages. However, most existing methods mainly rely on semantic alignment between texts and targets, while ignoring the reasoning process required for reliable stance inference. Although Large Language Models provide strong reasoning ability, their high computational cost and inference latency limit practical deployment. To address these limitations, we propose a rationale-guided knowledge distillation framework for cross-lingual stance detection. Specifically, we use Chain-of-Thought prompting to guide Large Language Models in generating informative rationales, and distill the resulting reasoning knowledge into a compact student model. We further design a dual-path distillation mechanism to align rationale-enhanced and rationale-free representations, together with their prediction distributions. In addition, two contrastive learning strategies are introduced to improve stance discrimination. Experiments on multilingual benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms competitive baselines.
2607.18693.paper_summary_zh: 立場檢測旨在識別文本是否對特定目標表達出有利或對立的態度，並且對於各種下游應用來說是一項重要任務。儘管現有研究在單語環境中取得了強勁的表現，特別是在英語方面，但許多低資源語言，如加泰羅尼亞語，仍然缺乏足夠的標註數據來訓練有效的模型。跨語言立場檢測通過將來自資源豐富語言的立場知識轉移到低資源語言來緩解這一問題。然而，大多數現有方法主要依賴於文本與目標之間的語義對齊，而忽略了進行可靠立場推斷所需的推理過程。儘管大型語言模型提供了強大的推理能力，但其高計算成本和推斷延遲限制了實際部署。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一種基於推理的知識蒸餾框架，用於跨語言立場檢測。具體而言，我們使用思維鏈提示來引導大型語言模型生成有信息的推理，並將生成的推理知識蒸餾到一個緊湊的學生模型中。我們進一步設計了一種雙路徑蒸餾機制，以對齊增強推理和無推理的表示，連同它們的預測分佈。此外，引入了兩種對比學習策略以改善立場區分。在多語言基準上的實驗表明，我們的方法始終優於競爭基準。
